Set up comfort/eco setpoint switching for the Wohnzimmer: use an AnalogMultiplexer to select 22°C when the room is occupied and 18°C when empty, and wire the output to the Raumregler setpoint input

Build a 3-mode occupancy setpoint selector for the Wohnzimmer Raumregler: AnalogMultiplexer with comfort=22°C, eco=18°C, off=15°C. Wire a NotEqual block to detect when the mode is not 'off', and feed the multiplexer output to the IRC setpoint

Add a 2-minute window-close delay before re-enabling heating: when Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer goes low, start an OnDelay, and only clear Raumregler.Window after 2 minutes so the heating doesn't cycle rapidly

Combine the Wohnzimmer window and door contacts into a single heating inhibit signal: wire both Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer and Türkontakt Wohnzimmer through an Or gate, then into a Memory block to latch the 'window open' state, and connect Memory.Q to Raumregler.Window

Configure the Bad as a heating zone: add a Raumregler (IRC), wire Raumtemperatur Bad to the Temp input, Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad to InHumid, and Fensterkontakt Bad to the Window inhibit input
Add an AnalogMultiplexer for bathroom IRC mode selection: Input1=comfort (22°C), Input2=eco (20°C). Wire the output to Raumregler Bad.AMode to switch the IRC operating mode based on room occupancy
